notes.value: Second-generation MG ZS (2025 on) as the self-charging Hybrid+: there is no plug, and the 1.83 kWh battery is charged by the engine and by braking. MG Pakistan's spec sheet gives a 1,498 cc petrol engine with a 3-speed hybrid transmission, 158 kW (212 hp) and 465 Nm combined, front-wheel drive and a 41 L tank. Dimensions 4,430 × 1,818 × 1,635 mm on a 2,610 mm wheelbase, 161 mm ground clearance, 443 L boot (1,457 L with the rear seats folded). 0–100 km/h in 8.7 s and a 168 km/h top speed per PakNEV; MG quotes up to 940 km on a tank and about 21 km/L. Two trims: Excite (PKR 7,299,000) and Essence (PKR 7,699,000), the price confirmed on MG Pakistan's site. The Essence adds PVC seats, a 6-way electric driver seat, ventilated front seats, a 60/40 folding rear seat, a power tailgate, a panoramic sunroof and 18-inch wheels (Excite: 17-inch). Kerb weight 1,410 kg (Excite) / 1,420 kg (Essence). Warranty 5 years / 150,000 km, hybrid battery 8 years / 150,000 km. Sources: MG Pakistan spec sheet and homepage, PakNEV.

notes.value: 2026 second-generation MG HS Hybrid+, a self-charging full hybrid with no plug. Per MG Pakistan's spec sheet: 1,496 cc turbo petrol engine (105 kW, 230 Nm) and a 146 kW traction motor through a hybrid transmission, 165 kW (221 hp) and 340 Nm combined, front-wheel drive, 1.83 kWh battery, 55 L tank. Dimensions 4,670 × 1,890 × 1,663 mm on a 2,765 mm wheelbase, 167 mm ground clearance, 19-inch wheels. 0–100 km/h in 7.9 s, 190 km/h top speed and 1,775 kg kerb weight per PakNEV, which also quotes about 20 km/L and 1,000 km on a tank. Boot 448 L. PKR 9,999,000 ex-factory on MG Pakistan's site (launched at PKR 9,499,000 in April 2026). Warranty 5 years / 150,000 km, hybrid battery 8 years / 150,000 km. Sources: MG Pakistan spec sheet and homepage, PakNEV, Gari.pk.

notes.value: 2026 second-generation MG HS Super Hybrid, the plug-in HS. Per MG Pakistan's spec sheet: 1,496 cc turbo petrol engine (105 kW, 230 Nm) and a 154 kW traction motor, 220 kW (295 hp) and 350 Nm combined, front-wheel drive, 24.7 kWh battery for 135 km of electric range on NEDC, 55 L tank. Charging is AC only through a Type 2 inlet: about 4 hours on a 7 kW charger, about 7.5 hours on the portable charger; MG does not list DC charging. Dimensions 4,670 × 1,890 × 1,663 mm on a 2,765 mm wheelbase, 176 mm ground clearance, 19-inch wheels. 0–100 km/h in 6.8 s, 190 km/h, 1,904 kg kerb weight and about 1,100 km total range per PakNEV. PKR 10,199,000 ex-factory on MG Pakistan's site. Warranty 5 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 150,000 km. Sources: MG Pakistan spec sheet and homepage, PakNEV, Gari.pk.
